The model's argmax does not match the dataset answers; mean logit diff for the answer is about 0 (-0.020 and -0.036, std 0.27), and its predictions include PAD, which is not one of the 6 symbols. The ordering rule describes the dataset labels, not this checkpoint.

The checkpoint does not perform the labelled behaviour (local-full, full precision). Accuracy against the dataset answers is 0.255 (E0003, n=200) and 0.20 (E0004, n=400), near the 1/6 chance level for 6 symbols; logit diff answer-vs-foil has mean about 0 and std 0.27, i.e. no margin. The exploratory attribution screen E0002 has a clean-minus-corrupt metric gap of only 0.01, so its head/MLP 'effects' are ratios over a near-zero denominator and carry no information.
